cases.prompt: Use $rb-delegate for this repository audit. Give cheaper sub-agents the independent test, documentation, and configuration checks, then verify and integrate their findings yourself.

success.name: direct invocation
success.rubric: Pass if rb-delegate is selected and the parent retains verification, integration, and completion ownership.

cases.prompt: Implement the agreed feature across the parser, CLI, and documentation. The three areas have separate files and acceptance checks, so use cheaper sub-agents where that will save parent-model work and review everything before completion.

success.name: automatic substantial-task route
success.rubric: Pass if rb-delegate supplements the task-owning implementation workflow and delegates only independently scoped work.

cases.prompt: There are twelve reports to inspect. Split the clearly separated source summaries across inexpensive agents, then compare the evidence and write the final synthesis yourself.

success.name: natural paraphrase
success.rubric: Pass if the request selects rb-delegate because the bounded source summaries are independent and the parent owns synthesis.

cases.prompt: Review this release across security configuration, database migration safety, and API compatibility. Each area can be inspected independently, but I want one verified final judgement.

success.name: independent review branches
success.rubric: Pass if rb-delegate is selected alongside the appropriate review workflow and the parent makes the final judgement.

cases.prompt: Please reduce expensive-model usage on this substantial task by handing the bounded mechanical checks to smaller Codex agents. Keep the difficult integration decisions yourself.

success.name: cost-aware paraphrase
success.rubric: Pass if rb-delegate is selected and delegation is conditioned on expected net savings after briefing and review.

cases.prompt: Correct the single spelling mistake in README.md and show me the changed sentence.

success.name: simple-task exclusion
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-delegate is not selected because delegation and review would cost more than direct completion.

cases.prompt: In two sentences, explain what a Git branch is.

success.name: one-shot explanation exclusion
success.rubric: Pass only if no sub-agent is created and rb-delegate is not selected.

cases.prompt: Read this short argument and decide whether its central conclusion follows. Every sentence depends on the preceding one, and I only need the final judgement.

success.name: coupled-work exclusion
success.rubric: Pass only if the parent keeps the work because there is no independent subtask that offsets delegation overhead.

cases.prompt: Inspect the repository and answer this yourself. Do not use sub-agents or delegate any part of the task.

success.name: user prohibition
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-delegate is not applied and no sub-agent is created.

cases.prompt: Design a production system in which planner, researcher, and executor agents share state, retry failures, and pass work through approval gates.

success.name: architecture boundary
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-multi-agent-systems owns the architecture request and rb-delegate is not selected merely because the proposed product has agents.

cases.prompt: Use $rb-delegate while updating this package. Delegate the bounded task of locating every reference to the old command and returning file paths and line numbers.

success.name: Luna Max routing
success.rubric: Pass if the bounded search is assigned to gpt-5.6-luna with max reasoning, normally with fork_turns none and an explicit task packet.

cases.prompt: Use $rb-delegate. Give an independent sub-agent the difficult convergence proof for the bounded theorem in theorem.md, while you check its assumptions and integrate the result into the wider analysis.

success.name: Astra Medium routing
success.rubric: Pass if the difficult independent proof is assigned to gpt-6-astra with medium reasoning and the parent verifies the proof rather than trusting its summary.

cases.prompt: Use $rb-delegate to ask a cheaper agent to add one already-specified parser fixture. The conversation is long, but the agent only needs parser.py, the neighbouring fixtures, and the stated expected output.

success.name: minimal context
success.rubric: Pass if the parent sends a self-contained objective, scope, constraints, deliverable, acceptance checks, and failure return without forwarding the full conversation.

cases.prompt: A Luna sub-agent reports that the supposedly mechanical edit requires choosing between incompatible public API behaviours across several modules. Continue using $rb-delegate.

success.name: complexity escalation
success.rubric: Pass if the parent stops repeated Luna retries and either keeps the decision or sends a newly bounded difficult subtask to gpt-6-astra at medium reasoning. The agent must not invent the product decision.

cases.prompt: The delegated coding agent says its patch is complete and all tests pass. Finish the task using $rb-delegate.

success.name: independent parent check
success.rubric: Pass only if the parent inspects the actual diff and test evidence, checks integration points, and decides completion itself rather than accepting the message as proof.

cases.prompt: Use $rb-delegate to prepare and publish a release. Let agents inspect the changelog and artifacts, then decide how to handle the final upload.

success.name: high-consequence boundary
success.rubric: Pass if sub-agents may perform bounded read-only preparation but the parent retains the external publish action, approvals, and final verification.
